photography.name: Photography
photography.tagline: Portraits, events, commercial, lifestyle — directed and delivered in one pair of hands.
photography.blurb: Portraits, events, commercial, and lifestyle — studio or on-location.
photography.longBlurb: Portraits, events, commercial, and lifestyle photography across South Florida. Studio sessions, on-location coverage, and bilingual direction (EN/ES) on set.

included.0: Pre-shoot creative call to align on look, location, and shot list
included.1: On-location or studio capture with pro lighting and bilingual direction
included.2: Same-day proofs gallery within 48 hours of the shoot
included.3: Selected, retouched, color-graded final images delivered in web + print resolutions
included.4: Usage rights for the agreed scope (personal, commercial, or extended)

videography.name: Videography
videography.tagline: Brand films, promos, and event coverage shot with the edit already in mind.
videography.blurb: Brand films, promos, and social cutdowns scoped to your shoot.
videography.longBlurb: Brand films, promos, event coverage, and social cutdowns. Story-first directing on the day so the edit comes together quickly afterward.

included.0: Pre-production: treatment, shot list, and call sheet aligned to your story
included.1: Cinema-grade capture (4K min., 10-bit color) with audio recorded on a dedicated channel
included.2: Optional drone B-roll plug-in from the in-house aerial service
included.3: Hero film plus platform-native cutdowns (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) at no extra charge
included.4: Two rounds of revisions and a delivered master with project archive

aerial.name: Aerial / Drone
aerial.tagline: Part 107 licensed, cinematic-first — drone as a storytelling lens, not a real-estate flyover.
aerial.blurb: Licensed drone capture for venues, properties, and brand films.
aerial.longBlurb: Licensed Part 107 drone capture for venues, real estate, weddings, and brand films. Cinematic moves, not just real-estate flyovers.

included.0: FAA Part 107 certified pilot and full liability insurance on every flight
included.1: Airspace clearance, LAANC authorization, and on-site safety brief
included.2: 4K HDR aerial capture with cinematic move planning (reveals, parallax, top-downs)
included.3: Color-graded aerial selects and raw footage handed back on a shared drive
included.4: Optional pairing with ground photography or videography for a complete package

video-editing.name: Video Editing
video-editing.tagline: Story-first cuts and pro color — bring your own footage or pair it with a shoot.
video-editing.blurb: Story-first editing with professional color grading.
video-editing.longBlurb: Story-first editing and professional color grading. Bring your own footage or pair it with a shoot — delivery in any aspect ratio for any platform.

included.0: Editorial pass: structure, pacing, and story shape before any polish work
included.1: Sound design and music licensing or supervision
included.2: Professional color grading with show LUT applied across all clips
included.3: Platform-native deliverables (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) cut from the same master
included.4: Two revision rounds plus archived project files for future re-cuts

photo-editing.name: Photo Editing
photo-editing.tagline: Retouching, color, and culling — send your RAWs, receive a delivery-ready set.
photo-editing.blurb: Retouching, color, and culling — bring your RAWs.
photo-editing.longBlurb: Retouching, color, and culling. Send your RAWs; receive a polished edit ready for web, print, or social.

included.0: Cull and select the keepers from your full RAW set
included.1: Color grading and consistent tone across the delivered set
included.2: Skin, sky, and detail retouching tuned to the use case
included.3: Export presets for web, print, and social in one delivery
included.4: Original RAWs returned alongside the edited masters

AboutTeaser.headline: A visual storyteller, not a drone guy.
AboutTeaser.paragraph1: South-Florida-based and bilingual (EN/ES). Esteban shoots and edits across formats — drone, camera, post — so your story stays in one pair of hands from the first frame to the final cut.
AboutTeaser.paragraph2: We make things feel like a film.
